VOTABLE.DESCRIPTION: LAMOST, the The Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope (or Guoshoujing Telescope) is an instrument tailored for producing large number of optical medium- and low-resolution spectra. Here, we publish both the medium (MRS) and low (LRS) resolution spectra from Data Release 6, http://dr6.lamost.org/v2/, to the Virtual Observatory.

TABLE.name: ssa_mrs
TABLE.DESCRIPTION: SSA-compliant metadata for LAMOST DR6 medium resolution spectra; this data is also availble through Obscore; the collection name there is LAMOST6 MRS.

GROUP.name: note-fib
GROUP.DESCRIPTION:
Meaning of the bits in fibermask (note: while upstream counts bits from 1, we count bits from 0):
=== ================================================ Bit Meaning === ================================================ 0 Fiber not allotted 1 Bad trace from the TRACECENTER routine 2 Low counts in flat field 3 Bad arc solution 4 <10% pixels are bad on the CCD 5 <10% pixels are saturated 6 Whopping fiber 7 Near a whopping fiber 8 Sky fiber shows extreme residuals === ================================================

FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Processing/Creation date

FIELD.name: ssa_pdate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Date last published.

FIELD.name: ssa_bandpass
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Bandpass (i.e., rough spectral location) of this dataset; this should be the most appropriate term from the vocabulary http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/messenger.

FIELD.name: ssa_targetpos
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Equatorial (ICRS) position of the target object.

FIELD.name: ssa_snr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Median signal to noise ratio over all pixel, computed as flux/sqrt(variance)

FIELD.name: ssa_location

FIELD.name: ssa_model

FIELD.name: ssa_csysName
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: System RA and Dec are given in

FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in rv_lasp1.

FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag for RV extraction in the b band: 0 – no anomalies; 1 – too many bad pixels; 2 – radial velocity in excess of 450 km/s; 3 – low similarity with best-matched template.

FIELD.name: rv_r_flag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag for RV extraction in the r band: 0 – no anomalies; 1 – too many bad pixels; 2 – radial velocity in excess of 450 km/s; 3 – low similarity with best-matched template.

FIELD.name: rv_br_flag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag for RV extraction in the br band: 0 – no anomalies; 1 – too many bad pixels; 2 – radial velocity in excess of 450 km/s; 3 – low similarity with best-matched template.

FIELD.DESCRIPTION: 1 if this is a co-added spectrum

FIELD.name: fibermask
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Bitmask for fiber problems. See note for the meaning for the bits.

FIELD.name: bad_b
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: 1 if this is a problematic B spectrum.

FIELD.name: bad_r
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: 1 if this is a problematic R spectrum.
